finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were really broken, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` took the discount off the base, then taxed the *undiscounted* base. So tax was overcharged.

Fixed in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Tax now applies to the discounted amount, which matches the doc comment above it.

Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so they hid the bug. Only the 3 rows with both non-zero caught it.
